notes: New: the Agent screen has a fourth tab, "Z.ai", next to Claude Code, DeepSeek and Antigravity. It runs chat.z.ai in a hidden in-app browser with your own signed-in free Z.ai account, so no API key is needed. Sign in once through the visible sign-in screen (the session stays on the device, cookies persist), check the connection with one tap, then type a task: the app sends it to chat.z.ai, watches for the reply to finish (stop indicator gone + text stable + timeout - never one signal alone), and shows the answer, code blocks and any files the model produced. Tasks ask Z.ai to output every file as a separate "FILE: path" code block; the app extracts and saves them to app storage. If chat.z.ai shows a sign-in page or a verification puzzle, the app stops cleanly with a clear message instead of hanging. The three existing CLI agents, their installs and the provider settings are untouched. Same signing key - installs directly over v1.0.18 with one tap.
